completion_data.completion_summary: Threaded MODEL_FLAG from commands/orchestrate.md through skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md's Stage 1/Stage MT-1 context parse, Stage 3.5 Dispatch Prep's model-override resolution, and out to all 12 lifecycle dispatch sites (8 Stage 4 tables, 3 Stage MT-4 loops, 1 Stage 3.6 team fan-out loop) as the Agent tool's model parameter, with a verified no-flag regression trace proving byte-identical behavior when unset.

memory_candidates.content: When threading a new flag through /orchestrate's two-file architecture (commands/orchestrate.md + skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md), commands/orchestrate.md needs 4 insertion points per dispatch site (both a flat args: Skill string AND a separate JSON delegation-context object, at each of its 2 dispatch sites), not 2 as in the simpler single-args-string pattern used by commands/research.md. Missing the JSON half leaves the flag unreachable from the context payload.

parse-command-args.sh's MODEL_FLAG (and similar flags) default to empty string "", not JSON null, even though some command prose (e.g. commands/research.md) frames the unset case as `model_flag = null`. Every emptiness check written when threading such a flag must test for the empty string, never the literal token null, or the no-flag regression breaks.
